title: Certify a complete tariff barrier for staged544 terminal-only extensions
body:
## Result

At PR3945's exact tariff parameter `κ = 1730663236534549309146/10^24`, terminal-only enlargement loses more than **0.006843664113335406486182 tariff units per added dimension**, even allowing arbitrary fractional owner repacking. Keep helper entrances and all paid interior scalar/native frames fixed; terminal subspaces may be noncoordinate and changes may differ per call. The credited packing dual bounds idle credit by `q < 0.987736182658129815011784`, while terminal rank concavity forces a surcharge `m > 0.994579846771465221497966`.

This supplies a quantified budget gate for further changed-boundary work: an interior refit must beat `(m-q)D` before an added terminal dimension can pay. It **does not close PR3945's joint interior/native refits**, change the selected frontier, or claim a new κ.

The binary-subspace rank argument is paired with capacitated packing/linear-program duality. The dual formula is prior work from PR3815/3862/3890, independently rechecked here at the changed PR3945 endpoint; the new result is its combination with exact terminal costs and binding to the current literal allocation.

## Evidence and bounded pivot

- All **841 patterns** of widths5..9:11 symbolic tight,830 strictly positive with exact rational power bounds.
- Both provider frame invoices and the full incumbent local-plus-idle profile reproduced.
- Full external source scan: **1,321,920 roles and725,760 bins**. Every actual pattern attains the dual; every occupied slack bin contains only full-dimension helpers. Thus retaining owner identities permits zero positive extensions.
- A concrete mixed pivot is also priced: exactly17 protected width5 terminals per provider admit a direct rank1 refund. The extended width4..9 dual checks **2,551 patterns** and charges exactly one idle unit back for each saved rank1 terminal child. These refunds cannot finance extensions. Broader mixed changes remain outside scope.
- Positive rank1-gap absorption and noncoordinate-frame fixtures; actual optimized CLI mutations of dual, capacity, missing empty bins and source bytes reject.

Default registered replay is standard-library and checks the exact theorem, both local invoices, aggregate integer owner certificate and controls. The literal full-owner scan uses explicitly fetched, immutable external inputs; default CI does not silently claim that scan. `VALIDATION.json` records exact executed modes. Final frozen registered replay passed in45.06s; optimized full-owner replay passed in35.11s. Exact GitHub-authored commit7d85649b64243022b3141df00c61027a083a533a passes the committed-byte/source-history gate and official export integrity checks. The proof, source pins, complete cost-status ledger and open next question are in the package.

## Scope and next step

No candidate circuit is emitted. PR3969's exact arbitrary-dirty scalar/permutation identity and full chronology/family checks are inherited; this package freshly checks capacities and invoices. Native phase, physical realization, uniform precision/stock/tape/recovery, all-size compiler, outer release and analytic/BIT obligations remain inherited or unverified, never zero. The endpoint is used as a fixed tariff parameter, not independently recertified as a root or admitted supplier.

The next construction needs one literal interior frame change saving more than the stated per-dimension deficit, with an actual chronological owner reassignment and complete dirty/native bill. The full-budget screen gives no allowance for another terminal-only or direct-refund search.
